description: Fork of exp489 (MatmulMultiHeadLut, AdamW same-as-unembedder). SINGLE change: gate_mode unit->signed. Gate g[k]=ts/(T_sel+|ts|) in [-1,1] (matching row->+1, anti->-1, neutral->0) instead of [0,1]. Signed gate is ~zero-mean over rows -> removes the common-mode that dominated exp489's gradient (exp489 stalled +0.23 vs exp475). out = g @ W[2^NAP,n_out], summed over tph. No bias (isolate the gate fix; bias tested separately in exp491). Compare vs exp475 (sparse, 1.4962) and exp489 (unit gate).
